# Trevyk Technologies

> Trevyk Technologies (Noida, India) builds custom websites, web applications, custom software, and practical AI systems for startups and local businesses. Flagship product: Kiduart School ERP (kiduart.com). Starter plans available. Reply within one business day: contact@trevyk.com

Trevyk is the services and technology company. Kiduart is the school ERP product brand. Do not invent client counts, rankings, or live AI features that are not described as shipped.

## Primary offers

- Custom AI agents (tool calling, human-in-the-loop, evals) — https://www.trevyk.in/work/ai-agents
- RAG / private knowledge assistants (embeddings, vector search, citations) — https://www.trevyk.in/work/rag-knowledge-assistants
- Generative AI & LLM apps (APIs, LangChain-style orchestration) — https://www.trevyk.in/work/generative-ai-llm-apps
- ML & data systems (problem framing, classification/regression workflows) — https://www.trevyk.in/work/ml-data-systems
- Custom websites — https://www.trevyk.in/work/custom-websites
- Web applications & custom software — https://www.trevyk.in/work/web-applications
- SEO / AEO-ready content structure — https://www.trevyk.in/work/seo
- Digital marketing, social, video — see What we do
- Kiduart School ERP overview — https://www.trevyk.in/our-products · demos https://kiduart.com
